Hi Oliver / Team,

Ben here (security engineer at Redwood) — thanks for the questions. A few technical clarifications to help your review and speed the CAIQ completion: 

1) Data flow: By default, inference requests are transient — prompts and generated outputs are not persisted to durable customer storage unless explicitly configured. We capture short-lived KV cache for model performance, which is evicted within session lifecycle and not written to long-term storage. We can provide an architecture diagram (attached) showing ingress, inference runtime, KV cache lifecycle, and egress controls.

2) Encryption / keys: At rest we use AES-256; platform KMS (cloud provider) is the default. For dedicated/private customers we support customer-managed keys (CMKs) with rotation policies. Key access is limited to the control plane for disaster recovery; we can provide an HSM/KMS integration diagram and Key Access Matrix as evidence.

3) Logging / retention: Application logs are retained 90 days by default; audit logs for admin actions are retained for 365 days. We can provide redacted log extracts and the retention policy document.

4) BAA / PHI: If StrandTech expands to PHI, we’ll route this to legal. The technical controls needed for PHI (VPC-only access, dedicated capacity, strict key control) are available and we have a standard checklist to satisfy HIPAA technical safeguards.

I’m attaching an evidence mapping workbook (redwood_evidence_map_20261105.xlsx) that maps CAIQ sections to artifacts we can provide. Happy to join the kickoff to walk the mapping — please send the calendar invite.

Regards,
